short_description: SOFIA HAWC+ far-infrared camera and polarimeter, band B

licence.terms: "Authors who utilize SOFIA data should provide the following acknowledgement in their publications"
licence.scope: Owner is the SOFIA mission (NASA/DLR; SOFIA Science Center at IRSA/IPAC, USRA, DSI). Statement from the SOFIA Science Center 'Information for Authors' page (owner's publication terms, level 2); it conditions use of SOFIA data on an acknowledgement but gives no formal licence, and covers SOFIA data generally, not the filter-profile files specifically. The sofia.usra.edu site did not answer to curl (connection timeout) on 2026-10-26, so the IRSA-hosted SOFIA Science Center copy was used. Source page SVO cites: not recorded in info.json (empty). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Based [in part] on observations made with the NASA/DLR Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy (SOFIA). SOFIA is jointly operated by the Universities Space Research Association, Inc. (USRA) under a NASA contract and the Deutsches SOFIA Institut (DSI) under DLR contract 50 OK 2002 to the University of Stuttgart.
